date_basis: UTC calendar dates. Each row is the end-of-day on-chain reserve state.
sources: Algorand indexer https://mainnet-idx.algonode.cloud account transactions for Tinyman and LiquiHog STAMM pool addresses, replayed to reconstruct reserves
Algorand indexer application transactions for Pact AETF/HOG app 3775943032 and Pact AETF/USDC app 3775940320, using global-state-delta reserve_a/reserve_b (absolute values)
Live reserves from indexer account and application endpoints (same method as aetherisetf.com)
method: Daily last observed reserves, with unchanged end-of-day balances carried through days that had no reserve-changing transaction. HOG USD is the pool-implied mark: (AETF/USDC liquidity-weighted dollar mark) * (AETF in AETF/HOG pools) / (HOG in those pools). No interpolated prices or invented inventory. Days before a venue's first reserve snapshot are recorded as zero at that venue.
